overview: The City Council approved a petition to remove police leadership from civil service and referred a modernized ordinance for the Commission for Persons with Disabilities to legal review. The Council also finalized its collective recommendations and schedule for the Fiscal Year 2027 budget process.

items.title: Meeting Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the meeting records of March 10, 2026, and reports from the Planning and Permitting Committee concerning the vacant building ordinance and zoning cleanup.

items.title: Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a resolution to update the Commission for Persons with Disabilities ordinance to legal review with Council support; the proposal aims to modernize terminology and clarify the commission's role.

items.title: License Amendment: Ho-Win Palace
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the common victualler's license for Ho-Win Palace to extend operating hours until 1:00 a.m., subject to a standard 30-60-90 day review.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2027 Budget Process
items.summary: Approved the Fiscal Year 2027 budget schedule and authorized the Council President to submit a collective memo of departmental recommendations to the mayor.

items.title: Inclusion Specialist Update
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Education and Culture subcommittee to request a progress update from the administration regarding the hiring of a city inclusion specialist.

items.title: Civil Service Exemption: Police Leadership
items.summary: Approved a petition for special legislation to exempt the positions of Police Chief and Deputy Police Chief from civil service regulations, a measure supported by both the administration and police unions.

items.title: Food Truck Permits: Charlie Dogs
items.summary: Approved food truck permits for Charlie Dogs to operate at Hormel Stadium during Boston Glory games through August 2026.
